flagged.sentence: 一种解释是：他没有把出海说成上策，只说成不得已。
原文没有说这些理由是否当众向全队讲过；
The original does not say whether those reasons were put to the whole party;
这只是一种解释，原文没有说明他为什么这样安排。

A remote station of a few people, supplies good for another stretch of time, communications down, the next resupply date unknown: does everyone stay and endure, or does someone go out and risk seeking help?
只说“你看着办”却不讲失败的下场，责任就悬在半空。
作者说，南乔治亚航程的记述依据逐日写下的简略笔记，笔记通常只记距离、船位和天气，航程中的具体经过则来自记忆。

episode.outcome: In the read range, the James Caird voyage ends when they force their way into King Haakon Bay, run into a small cove at dusk and land. All six get safely ashore and kneel to drink at a fresh-water stream. The next morning they drag the boat above high-water mark. They still have to sail to the head of the bay and cross South Georgia overland before they can reach the whaling stations.
episode.quote: However, I made fast the line, and in a few minutes we were all safe on the beach, with the boat floating in the surging water just off the shore.

episode.outcome: The preface says what happened to the men left on Elephant Island: twenty-two of them sheltered under the two boats and kept themselves alive for four and a half months. The James Caird was later brought home from South Georgia to Liverpool.
episode.quote: The two last-named are still on the deso- xil PREFACE late sandy spit of Elephant Island, where under their shelter twenty-two of my comrades eked out a bare existence for four and a half months.

additions.start: The two last-named are still on the deso-
additions.end: after her adventurous voyage across the sub-Antarctic ocean.
additions.why: The whole piece turns on the worst-case arithmetic about the men left behind and the handover to Wild, yet it never says how they fared. The preface states that twenty-two men survived on Elephant Island for four and a half months, and that the James Caird was brought from South Georgia to Liverpool. Readers need this outcome.

additions.start: The rocky coast appeared to descend sheer to the sea.
additions.end: realized that our position had become desperate.
additions.why: When South Georgia was sighted on May 8, a landing would have been suicidal. They had to stand off overnight and were then caught by a hurricane on a dead lee shore. Without this passage the draft jumps from the sighting straight to entering the bay, which hides the most dangerous turn of the voyage. Together with E27 it completes the sequence.

additions.start: King Haakon Bay is an eight-mile sound
additions.end: We must sail to the head of the sound.
additions.why: This passage qualifies the landing. They came ashore on the opposite side of the island from the east-coast whaling stations, and glaciers and cliffs blocked any way inland. Reaching land did not yet mean help, which keeps readers from treating the landing as the rescue.

context_issues.problem: The draft goes straight from sighting South Georgia on May 8 to entering the bay on May 10. It leaves out that landing was impossible, that they had to stand off, and that a hurricane then drove them onto a dead lee shore where the boat was nearly lost. The draft cites E27 but does not use it. Readers will think the voyage was essentially over once land was sighted.

quote.quote: to have attempted a landing at that time would have been suicidal

context_issues.problem: The draft ends on the safe landing and drinking water, which makes the landing look like the rescue. They actually came ashore on the opposite side from the east-coast whaling stations, glaciers blocked the way inland, and an overland journey still lay ahead.

quote.quote: It was obvious that these glaciers and the precipitous slopes of the mountains barred our way inland from the cove.

context_issues.problem: The analysis rests on the worst-case reckoning for the men left behind, but the piece never tells readers that the source does give their outcome: twenty-two men held out on Elephant Island for four and a half months.

quote.quote: twenty-two of my comrades eked out a bare existence for four and a half months

context_issues.problem: The draft writes '有人提议' / 'One proposal was'. In the source, the proposal to take Blackborrow came from the two doctors, who were themselves staying on the island to care for the sick. The vague wording hides who made the proposal, and it is the basis for the unnecessary conjecture in analysis.1.

quote.quote: McIlroy and Macklin were both anxious to. go but realized that their duty lay on the island with the sick men. They suggested that I should take Blackborrow

context_issues.problem: The draft says the doctors feared an operation would be necessary, but never gives the follow-up. They believed they had no chloroform, then found some after the boat had left. The paragraph cites E31 without using it.

quote.quote: They were - under the impression then that they had no chloroform, but they found some subsequently in the medicine-chest after we had left.

review.overall: In the read range, the voyage ends with a safe landing in King Haakon Bay, and the preface gives the outcome for the men left on Elephant Island (four and a half months). The draft should add the hurricane and lee-shore danger after the sighting, the overland journey still ahead after landing, and the survival of the men left behind. It should delete the conjecture that the source does not say whether the reasons were told to the whole party, and drop the 'cannot be verified' and 'no calendar year given' wording.
